title: Migrate lichend.rs and end_to_end.rs slot-claim tests to COSE_Sign1
description: Child of l1qw.16.2, LANDS AFTER l1qw.16.2.2 (that one deletes legacy SlotClaim::encode/decode, which these files still use - compile breaks until migrated). (1) lichend.rs test helper signed_slot_claim (src/bin/lichend.rs:1980-1999) signs the legacy slot_claim_transcript and sets claim.signature - switch to: SlotClaim::new(iid, slots, superframe, sequence) with timestamp=Some(unix_now()+100) then claim.encode_cose(&private,&public) -> (Vec<u8> envelope, [u8;32] pubkey); update its call sites (at least :2024-2025 provision_noninitial_slot_store, grep for signed_slot_claim). (2) tests/end_to_end.rs:985-994 builds SlotClaim with legacy transcript signature and claim.encode() - replace with SlotClaim::new(remote_iid, slots, current_superframe, 0).with_timestamp() and claim.encode_cose(&claim_private,&claim_public); drop the slot_claim_transcript import. Keep assertions unchanged. Verify: cargo test -p lichen-gateway.
